feature: Secret-redaction guard on the capture path (FEAT-001)

tasks.title: Create secrets.fixtures.ts with SECRET_SAMPLES and BENIGN_SAMPLES
tasks.description: New file exporting SECRET_SAMPLES: ReadonlyArray<{kind,value}> covering aws_access_key, github_token, slack_token, stripe_key, private_key_block, jwt, connection_string_password, assigned_secret, high_entropy; and BENIGN_SAMPLES: ReadonlyArray<{label,value}> covering a 40-hex git SHA, a UUIDv4, a sha256:<64 hex> digest, base64 of a small JSON config blob (no context cue), a 32-char lowercase hex build id, a long file path, an npm integrity string. Every secret value must be format-valid for its pattern but obviously synthetic and low-entropy in its body (e.g. AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE, ghp_ + 36 chars of EXAMPLE-repeat) so repo scanners and push protection do not fire; the high_entropy sample is the sole exception and carries no vendor prefix. File header comment states all values are synthetic and non-functional. Kind labels must exactly match the SECRET_PATTERNS kind column in architecture.md.

tasks.title: Add SECRET_WINDOW_TEXT condensed-window fixture
tasks.description: Extend secrets.fixtures.ts with SECRET_WINDOW_TEXT: a realistic condensed transcript window in prose that embeds every SECRET_SAMPLES value inline, surrounded by ordinary session dialogue, and also embeds each BENIGN_SAMPLES value so one fixture exercises both the positive and false-positive paths. Assemble from SECRET_SAMPLES where readable so the window cannot drift out of sync with the sample list.

tasks.title: Write shannonEntropy unit tests (red)
tasks.description: New src/capture/secrets.test.ts. Assert shannonEntropy('') === 0, a single repeated character === 0, a uniform 4-symbol alphabet === 2, every hex-only BENIGN_SAMPLES value < 4.0 bits/char (the structural argument behind the 4.5 threshold), and the base64 JSON blob >= 4.5. Tests fail because the module does not exist yet.

tasks.title: Create secrets.ts scaffold and shannonEntropy (green)
tasks.description: New src/capture/secrets.ts with zero project imports. Export type RedactionMode = 'strict' | 'full', interface RedactionResult { text: string; redactions: string[] }, an empty ReadonlyArray SECRET_PATTERNS placeholder, a placeholder-format helper producing [REDACTED:<kind>], the PLACEHOLDER_RE guard /\[REDACTED:[a-z_]+\]/, and shannonEntropy(token): number in bits/char. Make task-003 pass.

tasks.title: Write strict-mode pattern tests (red)
tasks.description: Extend secrets.test.ts with a table-driven it.each over the strict-kind SECRET_SAMPLES entries: each value embedded in surrounding prose yields exactly one [REDACTED:<kind>] with the correct kind, zero verbatim occurrences of the value, and byte-identical surrounding prose. Add a case asserting kinds are returned in match order for a text containing two different strict secrets.

tasks.title: Implement strict SECRET_PATTERNS rows and the redactSecrets core loop (green)
tasks.description: Add the strict rows from architecture.md in table order (private_key_block first, then aws_access_key, github_token, github_pat, slack_token, slack_webhook, stripe_key, anthropic_key, openai_key, google_api_key, npm_token) and implement redactSecrets(text, mode='full'): filter rows by mode, apply each row as one whole-text String.replace pass over the previous pass's output, push one kind label per replaced span. Never call .test()/.exec() on the shared /g rows. Entry guard returns { text: text ?? '', redactions: [] } for non-string input.

tasks.title: Write full-mode pattern tests (red)
tasks.description: Extend secrets.test.ts with cases for jwt, connection_string_password, assigned_secret and bearer_header: each fires in 'full' mode and produces zero redactions in 'strict' mode. Assert group semantics explicitly — postgres://user: and @host/db survive around [REDACTED:connection_string_password], and the API_KEY= label survives around [REDACTED:assigned_secret]. Add false-positive cases that must NOT redact: api_key = process.env.FOO, token: null, password: <your-password>, secret = ***.

tasks.title: Implement full-mode rows with capture-group span replacement (green)
tasks.description: Add jwt, connection_string_password (group 1), assigned_secret (group 2) and bearer_header (group 1) rows, and extend the replace loop to honour the group field: replace only that group's span using the replacer's offset and group arguments plus absolute-index slicing — never match.replace(groupValue, placeholder), which mis-fires on repeated group values. Add the assigned_secret suppression list (placeholders, process.env./$/{/< prefixes, null/undefined/none/changeme, all-*/all-x values).

tasks.title: Write high-entropy backstop tests, including the zero-false-positive bound (red)
tasks.description: Extend secrets.test.ts: a context-cued opaque token (api_key= followed by a 32-char mixed-class token) is redacted as high_entropy in 'full' mode and not in 'strict'. Table-driven it.each over every BENIGN_SAMPLES entry asserting redactions === [] and text unchanged in 'full' mode. Exclusion cases: the same high-entropy token with no preceding credential keyword within 48 chars is not redacted; a 40-hex SHA, a UUIDv4 and a 23-char token are not redacted.

tasks.title: Implement the high_entropy heuristic (green)
tasks.description: Full-mode-only backstop appended after the named rows: scan /[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{24,}/g and flag only when ALL hold — length >= 24, shannonEntropy >= 4.5, >= 2 of {lowercase, uppercase, digit}, not pure hex, not UUID-shaped, not an already-emitted placeholder, and the 48 chars preceding the match end with the credential-keyword context cue regex. Order the cheap structural checks before the entropy computation. Clamp the context slice at index 0.

tasks.title: Write idempotence and purity tests (red)
tasks.description: Extend secrets.test.ts: redactSecrets(redactSecrets(SECRET_WINDOW_TEXT,'full').text,'full').text equals the single-pass output and the second pass returns redactions === []; the input string is not mutated; a clean input returns text equal to input with redactions === []; a text already containing a literal [REDACTED:aws_access_key] placeholder is left untouched by every row including the entropy backstop.

tasks.title: Harden the placeholder guard for idempotence (green)
tasks.description: Apply PLACEHOLDER_RE as a skip condition inside the row replacer and the entropy scan so no already-redacted span is re-matched, and so a second full pass over redacted text produces zero additional redactions. Add the accepted-limitation comment on private_key_block: an unterminated BEGIN block with no END does not match and is not redacted — no redact-to-end-of-text fallback.

tasks.title: Write internal fail-open test for redactSecrets (red)
tasks.description: Extend secrets.test.ts: temporarily substitute a SECRET_PATTERNS entry whose re throws (object with a throwing Symbol.replace), restored in afterEach. Assert redactSecrets returns the input text unchanged with redactions === [], does not throw, and that console.error was called. No secret value may appear in the logged arguments.

tasks.title: Add the internal try/catch fail-open to redactSecrets (green)
tasks.description: Wrap the redactSecrets body in try/catch returning { text, redactions: [] } on any internal failure, logging '[claude-nexus] secret redaction failed, text passed through unmodified:' plus the error only — never the text or any matched span.

tasks.title: Write redactCandidate tests (red)
tasks.description: Extend secrets.test.ts: redactCandidate scrubs title and body in 'full' mode; a tag that triggers any redaction is dropped from tags while clean tags survive in original order; a new candidate object is returned and the input is not mutated (deep-equality check on the original); kinds are aggregated across title, body and tags. Add a case passing an injected redactor as the optional second argument to prove the default parameter is overridable.

tasks.title: Implement redactCandidate with injectable redactor (green)
tasks.description: Export redactCandidate(c: MemoryCandidate, redact: typeof redactSecrets = redactSecrets): { candidate, redactions }. Scrub title and body in 'full' mode, map tags through the redactor and filter out any tag that produced a redaction, return a new candidate object spread from the input with no mutation, concatenate kinds in field order. The optional second parameter is a deliberate extension of the architecture interface so one injected double reaches both reflector gates.

tasks.title: Add surgical mixed secret-plus-insight test
tasks.description: Extend secrets.test.ts with the design's worked example: a candidate body such as 'the API_KEY env var must be set to sk_live_<value> before running the ingest job' is redacted in place — assert the surrounding sentence survives byte-identically on both sides of the placeholder, the candidate is not dropped or emptied, and exactly one redaction is reported. Verification task: expected to pass against the existing implementation; if it does not, fix secrets.ts in this task.
